notes.title: 『JETMAN』Update December 18, 2022
notes.content:
・I have made it so that you can play without problems on SteamDeck!

・You can switch the language setting (Japanese/English)!
　Press the LB button (or F1 key) to display the setting menu at the top of the screen

notes.title: 『JETMAN』MiniUpdate October 13, 2022
notes.content:
When you move the cursor to "Save" in the home menu,
Added text prompting to save.

Changed the button for determining "Title Page" in the home menu.
This is to prevent returning to the title screen by mistake.

notes.title: Demo Update Notice
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the "JETMAN" demo version!
The following corrections have been made.

[h3][b]Changed the main language setting from Japanese to English. [/b][/h3]

Those who have a language setting that does not correspond to either "Japanese" or "English"
"English" is displayed preferentially when the game is started.

Thank you for your cooperation.

tags.feature: Changed the main language setting from Japanese to English.

notes.title: "JETMAN" demo version will be released!
notes.content:
[h2][b]【Overview】[/b][/h2]

A demo version of the jump action game "JETMAN" that anyone can easily play with one button will be released!
The demo version will be delivered at the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest]Steam Next Festival[/url] from February 21, 2022.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4145017/0635b027f9df37e26726d4bd0879410724f20ed3.png[/img]

[h2][b]【About the demo version】[/b][/h2]

You can play all 8 stages at the beginning of the game.
You can experience the basic fun of "JETMAN".
[previewyoutube=esyUl5rcv90;full][/previewyoutube]



Twitter : [url=https://twitter.com/HatchMontblanc]@HatchMontblanc[/url]
